blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Panfilo “Ping” Lacson said he is willing to give Technical Education and Skills Development Authority (Tesda) Director-General Jose Francisco “Kiko” Benitez the benefit of the doubt that he did not know about the supposed P5 million allocation offered to him. His statement came Monday as Benitez, over the weekend, denied authorizing the supposed offer to Lacson made by a certain Stephanie on behalf of the agency. “At the very least, I’m willing to give him the benefit of the doubt na hindi niya alam,” Lacson said, referring to Benitez.
